name: claude-code-cross-session-messaging
description: What the Claude Code cross-session messaging docs leave out: the peer's reply and its idle notice are different signals, so read the answer from the reply; recovering a reply that lands after /clear (the rewind menu's previous-session entry or /resume first, a grep for this session's own name as the fallback); never fabricating a reply that has not arrived; diagnosing a silent agent now that -p denies rather than waits and teammate and background-subagent permission prompts surface in the lead session; and the dividing line where a launch-a-callee tool is still the right answer.
author: voitta-ai
